about_the_game:
Jurassic Gym is a cute idle management game that sits at the bottom your screen, letting you focus on staying productive (or even playing other games!) while managing your very own dinosaur gym.

Watch Your Dinosaurs Get RIPPED On Their Own

Jurassic Gym doesn't feature any annoying popups, notifications, or events that demand your immediate attention. Your team of dinos will carry on with their training without your input - leveling their stats and earning you money all by themselves!

When you're ready to get hands-on, you can manage the gym, focus each dinosaur's training, and send your team off to competitions to your heart's content. 

Build Your Perfect Gym

Choose what equipment you buy and upgrade, decorate each room to your liking, and expand your gym to make space for your ever-growing team.

Hatch More Friends 

Grow your roster by acquiring and hatching new eggs. Be sure to keep your eye out for those very rare LEGENDARY dinosaurs that can help skyrocket the success of your gym!

Watch Them Grow & Test Their Might 

As your dinosaurs train their stats, you'll see them improve at all the activities in the gym. With these newfound skills, you can put together a team (or send a dino solo) to compete in various competitions. If they prove their mettle, they'll bring home medals that you can use to unlock even more options for customizing your gym!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-2500 / AMD FX-6350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 580, GeForce GTX 1060, Intel Arc A380, or similar (with 4+ GB of VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Run your own dinosaur gym on the bottom of your screen while you stay productive! Hatch new buddies, train them up, send them to competitions, and spend your winnings upgrading and customizing your Jurassic Gym.
